title: session-trace-localizer-and-instrumentation-api
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Introduce a lightweight "session trace localizer" consisting of an SDK API and a family of middleware for HTTP/gRPC/WebSocket that: 1) maps opaque global trace IDs into short deterministic session-lineage tokens for product-facing dashboards; 2) propagates sampling hints and stability markers without altering upstream traceparent headers; 3) provides a minimal runtime hook for request lifecycle instrumentation (start/finish/phase markers) with <0.5% CPU overhead at typical qps; 4) gracefully interoperates with existing OpenTelemetry/traceparent headers and Redwood request contexts. Goals: reduce engineering friction when debugging multi-hop LLM inference requests by exposing a human-friendly session lineage id in logs/traces, preserve end-to-end trace fidelity for SRE, and avoid increasing tail latency. Non-goals: this is not a replacement for full OTEL SDKs or for deep span enrichment (that remains a separate effort).
acceptance_criteria: 1) SDK exposes start_session() and attach_localized_id() helpers; 2) middleware auto-injects X-Session-Lineage header and a sampling-hint header without modifying traceparent; 3) end-to-end unit and integration tests for HTTP/gRPC/WebSocket paths; 4) microbenchmarks demonstrate median added latency <100us and p99 <500us at 5k rps; 5) rollout plan documented and feature-flagged for canary traffic; 6) dashboards show session-lineage counts, number of hops, and error rates per lineage.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha: Created initial RFC and design doc. SRE requested explicit behavior when upstream traceparent is missing (we will synthesize a stable trace id but mark synthesized:true).
2026-03-04 - Liam: Spike implemented for HTTP middleware. Benchmark harness against edge-proxy at 2k rps shows ~40us median overhead. Pushed PR #8124 for review.
2026-03-06 - PM (Evan Park): Asked for ability to opt-out by route and for a toggle in the Console. Added as follow-up task under labels and console release requirements.

2026-03-08 - Review (R&D): Raised concerns about header bloat and interaction with header size limits on gRPC-Web. Decided to encode lineage token in compact Base62 and only include sampling-hint when different from inherited sampling decision.

2026-03-09 - Security: Requested a short threat model—confirmed lineage tokens contain no PII and are derived from deterministic hash of (trace_id + service-shard) with HMAC salt stored in vault. Security review required before wide rollout.
2026-03-11 - QA: Added integration test matrix for HTTP/gRPC/WebSocket and language SDKs. Found a bug in Node SDK where header casing broke middleware; PR #8152 fixes it.
2026-03-12 - Liam: Preparing canary rollout plan. Will gate by feature-flag and enable for 1% of internal traffic then 5% external. Console toggle and dashboards wired to show canary cohort metrics.
notes_and_tradeoffs: Trade-offs considered: 1) embedding lineage in trace metadata vs separate header — chose separate header to avoid OTEL SDK ambiguity and to keep lineage visible to downstream HTTP infrastructure; 2) deterministic short IDs vs random ephemeral IDs — deterministic chosen to aid correlating retries across shards but HMAC salt ensures non-guessability; 3) including sampling hint only when it provides information to avoid header size growth. Plan to extend to Dedicated/Private with a config flag controlling HMAC salt location (KMS vs local) to satisfy on-prem constraints.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: internal canary 1% traffic + observability checks (latency, errors, header size). Stage 2: expand to 5% external usage and surface Console toggle. Stage 3: opt-in for Dedicated tenants via cluster config. Stage 4: global enable with deprecation notice for teams that relied on older legacy lineage headers.
testing_plan: Unit tests for helpers and header encoding; integration tests across HTTP/gRPC/WebSocket; load tests on edge-proxy at 5k rps and backend at 10k rps; chaos tests simulating partial header loss; fuzz tests for header parsing; security fuzzing for HMAC salt handling.
migration_notes: Provide a compatibility helper that maps legacy X-Req-Session to X-Session-Lineage for 90-day overlap. Instrumentation team to run analytics job to surface most active legacy senders and communicate migration timeline.
